recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for FHIR-52892. If Pharmacy still wants an explicit generic code for a Baxter-roll-like packaging aid, handle that separately with an exact code, display, and definition in the appropriate terminology workflow.
issue_request: FHIR-52892 was an Applied/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy change request for R6 asking how to indicate that a MedicationDispense was supplied in an adherence or distribution packaging form such as a Baxter roll. The final Jira resolution required adding MedicationDispense.doseAdministrationAid, 0..1, with an example binding to Medication Dose Aids.
initial_application: Commit a94da33de370f06f3ea261e97bbc29f412dfc194, merged through HL7/fhir#3896, added MedicationDispense.doseAdministrationAid to source/medicationdispense/structuredefinition-MedicationDispense.xml. That implementation commit is already contained in the combined branch, but it did not have an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit trailer.
additional_context: MedicationDispense is active in source/fhir.ini and MedicationDispense.doseAdministrationAid is listed there. September 2025 Pharmacy WGM minutes confirm the same 9-0-0 decision and explain reuse of the existing MedicationRequest doseAdministrationAid pattern and Medication Dose Aids example binding. The minutes also mention interest in adding a code representing Baxter roll, but the final Jira resolution and PR did not specify exact terminology content; because the binding is example, no invented code was added during reconciliation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch. No source change was made because the authoritative current source already satisfies the applied Jira resolution.
